Test Scenario Objective: Cold Boot and Splash Screen Sequence
Preconditions: Device powered off with battery charged > 20%.
Execution Steps:
1. Press power button.
2. Observe LCD backlight, splash logo, status bar, and initial transition to Login screen.
Expected Result: Device boots within 3 seconds, displays splash screen, initializes all I2C/SPI buses without panic, and navigates to Login screen.
Actual Result: Pass - boots cleanly into Login UI

Test Scenario Objective: Real-Time Battery % and Voltage Reading
Preconditions: Device running on battery.
Execution Steps:
1. Check top-right status bar battery indicator.
2. Verify battery percentage and icon match actual cell voltage via AXP2101.
3. Connect USB-C charger and observe icon.
Expected Result: Battery percentage displays accurate level (0-100%). When USB charger is plugged in, charging status is detected and voltage increases.

Test Scenario Objective: Software Shutdown via Settings Menu
Preconditions: User logged in, on Settings screen.
Execution Steps:
1. Navigate to Settings.
2. Tap 'Power Off Device' button.
3. Confirm shutdown modal.
Expected Result: Device logs shutdown event, flushes NVS, commands AXP2101 PMIC to cut power rails, and device turns off completely.

Test Scenario Objective: Capacitive Touch Accuracy & Responsiveness
Preconditions: Device on Home or Tasks screen.
Execution Steps:
1. Tap interactive elements across all 4 quadrants of display.
2. Test drag/scroll on task and inventory lists.
3. Tap on-screen keypad buttons.
Expected Result: FT6336 controller reports touch coordinates accurately with zero lag or phantom touches. Lists scroll smoothly without stutter.

Test Scenario Objective: Display Orientation Changes (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°)
Preconditions: User in Settings screen.
Execution Steps:
1. Navigate to Settings -> Screen Rotation.
2. Select Landscape (0°), Portrait (90°), Inverted Landscape (180°), Inverted Portrait (270°).
3. Check layout adaptation.
Expected Result: Display reorients immediately. Touch coordinates dynamically map to new orientation. UI widgets resize to fit aspect ratio.

Test Scenario Objective: Global Persistent Top Status Bar Elements
Preconditions: Device booted and active.
Execution Steps:
1. Switch between Home, Tasks, Scan, Inventory, Setup screens.
2. Observe top status bar across all screens.
Expected Result: Top status bar remains persistent with screen title, Wi-Fi IP/status, BLE state, and battery indicator across all navigation screens.

Test Scenario Objective: User Login via On-Screen Touch Keyboard
Preconditions: Device on Login screen. Valid user credentials exist in NVS/server.
Execution Steps:
1. Tap Username field; enter valid User ID (e.g. '1').
2. Tap Password field; enter valid PIN/Pass.
3. Tap 'Login' button.
Expected Result: Login succeeds. Device switches to Home screen. Status bar displays active operator name. Server receives MQTT status update with user ID.

Test Scenario Objective: Instant User Login via Barcode / QR Badge Scan
Preconditions: Device on Login screen. User badge barcode prepared.
Execution Steps:
1. Aim scanner at operator badge barcode (e.g. SKU/ID '1' or 'OP-1001').
2. Press hardware scan trigger button.
Expected Result: GM65 reads barcode, emits success chime, automatically logs in operator without typing, and transitions directly to Home screen.
Actual Result: Pass - badge scan instant login verified

Test Scenario Objective: Supervisor / Admin Mode vs Operator Mode
Preconditions: Admin user (e.g. 'admin') and Operator user configured.
Execution Steps:
1. Login as standard Operator -> Verify assigned tasks view.
2. Logout and login as Supervisor/Admin -> Verify task access.
Expected Result: Operator only views tasks specifically assigned to their ID. Supervisor/Admin has visibility into all system tasks and advanced settings.

Test Scenario Objective: Session Termination and Screen Reset
Preconditions: User logged in.
Execution Steps:
1. From Home screen or Setup screen, tap 'Logout'.
2. Confirm logout.
Expected Result: Session clears, active task is aborted, user state resets to 'No Login', server is notified via MQTT, and UI returns to Login screen.

Test Scenario Objective: Hardware Button Scan Triggering (GPIO GM65)
Preconditions: Scanner booted, user logged in, physical trigger button connected.
Execution Steps:
1. Aim scanner at a standard 1D Code 128 barcode.
2. Pull hardware trigger switch.
3. Check scan response.
Expected Result: Scanner aimer illuminates, GM65 decodes barcode, emits success beep chime, and decoded string appears in application immediately.

Test Scenario Objective: Multi-Symbology Decoding (1D Barcodes & 2D QR Codes)
Preconditions: Sample test sheet with EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 39, Code 128, DataMatrix, and QR codes.
Execution Steps:
1. Scan each barcode symbology one by one.
2. Observe decoded output and beep feedback.
Expected Result: All supported symbologies decode accurately within < 100ms. String content matches encoded barcode data exactly.

Test Scenario Objective: Illumination LED and Collimation Aimer Control
Preconditions: User in Settings or MQTT hardware command.
Execution Steps:
1. Toggle Lighting switch in Settings (or send MQTT lighting: 100/0).
2. Toggle Collimation switch in Settings (or send collimation: 100/0).
Expected Result: GM65 lighting LED turns ON/OFF or dims as commanded. Red aiming beam turns ON/OFF accordingly.

Test Scenario Objective: Scan Audio Feedback (Success Chime vs Error Buzzer)
Preconditions: Device audio enabled.
Execution Steps:
1. Scan a valid barcode matching an inventory SKU.
2. Scan an invalid barcode or over-pick an item.
Expected Result: Valid scan triggers pleasant 2-tone success chime on speaker. Invalid/error scan triggers distinct low-pitched error buzz.

Test Scenario Objective: Inventory Sync from Server via MQTT (`config/inventory`)
Preconditions: Scanner connected to Wi-Fi and MQTT.
Execution Steps:
1. Add/edit an inventory SKU in the Web Dashboard.
2. Check Scanner Inventory screen.
Expected Result: Scanner receives retained MQTT payload on 'config/inventory', updates internal inventory list, and displays updated items on screen.

Test Scenario Objective: Inventory Search by SKU or Item Name
Preconditions: Inventory screen populated with multiple products.
Execution Steps:
1. Tap Search input bar.
2. Type SKU prefix (e.g. 'SKU-001') or name keyword (e.g. 'Apple').
Expected Result: Inventory list dynamically filters in real-time, showing only matching items with stock quantities.

Test Scenario Objective: Manual Stock Quantity Adjustment (+, -, Keypad)
Preconditions: Item selected in Inventory screen.
Execution Steps:
1. Tap an item in inventory list to open Qty Adjust screen.
2. Use '+' and '-' buttons or type new quantity.
3. Tap 'Save / Update'.
Expected Result: Quantity updates locally, transmits MQTT update to server database, and server reflects new stock count.

Test Scenario Objective: Online Task Assignment Sync (`device/<id>/tasks`)
Preconditions: Scanner logged in as Operator 1.
Execution Steps:
1. In Web Dashboard, create a new task assigned to Operator 1.
2. Check Tasks screen on scanner.
Expected Result: Task appears in real-time on scanner with Task Name, Priority badge (High/Med/Low), and item requirements count.

Test Scenario Objective: Task Item Checklist Fulfillment via Barcode Scan
Preconditions: Task active with required items (e.g. 5x SKU-001).
Execution Steps:
1. Open task.
2. Scan barcode for required SKU.
3. Observe picked counter (e.g. 1/5 -> 2/5).
Expected Result: Each valid scan increments picked count for that specific SKU, plays success chime, and updates item progress bar.

Test Scenario Objective: Prevent Over-Picking beyond Target Quantity
Preconditions: Item requirement fulfilled (e.g. 5/5 picked).
Execution Steps: 1. Attempt to scan the same SKU once more.
Expected Result: Scanner rejects scan, sounds error buzzer, displays 'Item Already Fulfilled' warning toast, and does not exceed required count.

Test Scenario Objective: Task Completion Event & Server Notification
Preconditions: All required items in task fully scanned.
Execution Steps:
1. Scan final required item.
2. Tap 'Complete Task' button (or auto-completes).
Expected Result: Scanner displays celebratory completion screen, publishes completion payload to 'device/<id>/task_complete', and task moves to completed on dashboard.

Test Scenario Objective: Wi-Fi AP Scan and Credential Storage to NVS
Preconditions: Device in Setup / Network screen.
Execution Steps:
1. Open Network screen.
2. Enter Wi-Fi SSID and Password.
3. Tap 'Connect & Save'.
Expected Result: Credentials are encrypted and saved to NVS namespace 'wifi_store'. ESP32 connects to AP, obtains DHCP IP, and reconnects automatically on reboot.
Actual Result: Pass - NVS storage and connect verified

Test Scenario Objective: Auto-Reconnection on Router Power Cycle
Preconditions: Device connected to Wi-Fi.
Execution Steps:
1. Turn off Wi-Fi router / mobile hotspot for 30 seconds.
2. Turn router back on.
Expected Result: Device detects STA disconnect, updates status bar to 'Disconnected', enters auto-reconnect loop, and reconnects automatically within 5s of AP reappearance.

Test Scenario Objective: MQTT Broker Reconnection & State Recovery
Preconditions: Device connected to local MQTT broker on port 1883.
Execution Steps:
1. Restart MQTT broker service on host.
2. Observe device connection behavior.
Expected Result: MQTT client automatically reconnects, re-subscribes to required topics (tasks, inventory, hardware, ota), and publishes 'online' status update.

Test Scenario Objective: BLE Device Name Format (`ScanPro-XXXX` with MAC)
Preconditions: BLE enabled on scanner.
Execution Steps:
1. Open Bluetooth settings on smartphone or PC.
2. Scan for available BLE devices.
Expected Result: Device appears as 'ScanPro-XXXX' where XXXX matches the last 4 characters of the device's hardware MAC address (e.g. 'ScanPro-5664').

Test Scenario Objective: BLE HID Keyboard Mode Pairing & Keystroke Injection
Preconditions: Smartphone / PC paired with scanner.
Execution Steps:
1. Pair scanner with phone or laptop.
2. Open Notepad or any text field on phone/PC.
3. Scan any barcode with scanner.
Expected Result: Scanned barcode characters are instantly typed into the active text field followed by an Enter key press, simulating a USB barcode gun.

Test Scenario Objective: BLE Service Toggle ON / OFF from Setup Screen
Preconditions: Device in Setup screen.
Execution Steps:
1. Tap 'Disable BLE' button -> Check Bluetooth visibility on phone.
2. Tap 'Enable BLE' button -> Check Bluetooth visibility.
Expected Result: When disabled, BLE stack stops advertising and disconnects. When enabled, BLE restarts advertising and status bar updates to 'BLE: Adv...'.

Test Scenario Objective: Microphone Recording & WebSocket Audio Streaming
Preconditions: Scanner and Web Dashboard both online.
Execution Steps:
1. Press and hold hardware PTT button (or on-screen PTT toggle).
2. Speak into scanner microphone.
3. Release PTT button.
Expected Result: ES8311 captures voice audio, filters silence via VAD, streams binary PCM packets over WebSocket to server, and server dashboard plays voice aloud.

Test Scenario Objective: Audio Announcement Reception and Speaker Playback
Preconditions: Scanner speaker enabled.
Execution Steps:
1. From Web Dashboard, trigger voice broadcast or chime to scanner.
2. Observe scanner speaker output.
Expected Result: TCA9554 P7 / GPIO17 enables speaker power amplifier, audio chunk streams into ring buffer, and speaker outputs clear audio without distortion.

Test Scenario Objective: Standard OTA Firmware Update (Happy Path)
Preconditions: Device online on Wi-Fi. New firmware uploaded on server.
Execution Steps:
1. Trigger OTA update from Web dashboard targeting scanner.
2. Observe full download and reboot.
Expected Result: Device transitions to OTA screen, downloads firmware (0% to 100%), verifies checksum, sets next boot partition, and reboots into updated version.

Test Scenario Objective: OTA Wi-Fi Disconnect mid-download and Auto-Resume
Preconditions: OTA download in progress at 50% - 75%.
Execution Steps:
1. Disconnect Wi-Fi during download.
2. Verify LCD shows 'Wi-Fi Lost (XX%)'.
3. Restore Wi-Fi.
Expected Result: Device detects drop within 4s, pauses cleanly, displays recovery message, sends HTTP Range header, resumes from exact percentage, and completes OTA.

Test Scenario Objective: Invalid / Corrupt Firmware File Upload Rejection
Preconditions: OTA triggered with non-ESP32 or corrupted binary file.
Execution Steps:
1. Deploy corrupted firmware binary.
2. Observe device verification and partition state.
Expected Result: Device detects invalid magic byte or fails esp_ota_end verification, aborts write, displays error toast, and remains safely on existing boot partition.

Test Scenario Objective: Free Heap and PSRAM Stability during Continuous Use
Preconditions: Device running continuous operations.
Execution Steps:
1. Execute 100 consecutive barcode scans.
2. Switch screens 50 times.
3. Transmit 10 PTT voice clips.
4. Monitor FreeRTOS heap telemetry.
Expected Result: No memory leaks observed. Internal SRAM remaining > 100KB, PSRAM remaining > 4MB. No task stack overflow or watchdog resets.

Test Scenario Objective: Rapid-Fire Barcode Scanning Stress Test
Preconditions: Device on Tasks or Scan screen.
Execution Steps: 1. Trigger hardware scan button 30 times in 15 seconds against various barcodes.
Expected Result: Scanner processes all scans sequentially without buffer overflow, lockup, or missed frames. UI scan counter increments accurately.

Test Scenario Objective: Extended 8-Hour Shift Uptime without Lockup
Preconditions: Scanner powered on in normal warehouse standby/active cycle for 8 hours.
Execution Steps:
1. Keep device active for full work shift.
2. Perform periodic scans, audio checks, and task updates.
Expected Result: Device remains responsive, maintains Wi-Fi and MQTT connectivity, battery drains smoothly according to power profile, zero reboots.
